2045. Thread Square Calculator

40

Medium

Problem Statement
Create a thread that calculates the square of a number and stores the result so the main thread can print it after the calculation completes.
Description
Read an integer num. Create a thread (extending Thread) whose run() method calculates the square of num and stores it in an instance variable. Start the thread, wait for it to finish using join(), then print the stored result from the main thread.
input_spec: A single line containing an integer num (-1000 ≤ num ≤ 1000).
output_spec: Print "Square: " followed by the square of num.
